name: App Icon: Slashed Dragon Koban
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Core Samurai + Money Theme.
description: Traditional Japanese oval gold Koban coin cleanly cleaved diagonally by a glowing crimson katana blade silhouette, centered in a circular crimson eclipse ring.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon symbolizing samurai fortune. An antique Japanese oval gold Koban coin silhouette with crimson stamped engravings, cleanly sliced diagonally by a sleek pitch-black katana blade with a razor-sharp glowing crimson cutting edge. (Framed by a giant perfectly smooth solid circular crimson-red sun halo:1.4). Pure pitch-black background, pristine vector geometry, sharp clean edges, iconic game logo, no 3D rendering, no text, no pixelation, no noise.
